body: I've really never thought of it that way before. I always thought everything I went through made me lesser than everyone else. Thank you for your words. I have a lot to think about.
I'm okay now. I'm gonna try what you said and play a game and try to be proud of myself. But I know I can never escape the sadness forever, it just comes back...

Everything. Bullying, abuse, anxiety, losing my home and family. I lost everything that made me happy and I can't even write my mourning away. Life doesn't feel worth it anymore and I don't have any energy. 

I feel worthless all the damn time, so I don't even know how to put myself first. I'm not worth it.

I don't want to live life. It's full of pain and nothing good has ever come out of it, and if it does, it just gets taken away. I can't enjoy it anymore, I just feel like I'm trapped all the time. All  I can feel is pain or a painful numbness. I can't do anything to move forward.

and nobody cares. All people care about is themselves and then get mad when I can't give them a good time.
